overview_description.description: Carefer Fleet is an embedded, cloud-based fleet maintenance management software. It seeks to enhance the effectiveness of clients' fleet maintenance by automating operations with special repair offers and guaranteed services that can be easily paid for, all in a single free software. It reduces the complex workflow of fleet maintenance to three simple steps and one piece of software.

product.name: Carefer Fleet
product.description: A cloud-based fleet maintenance management system that organizes, tracks, and automates vehicle maintenance operations for fleets of any size.

product.name: Carefer Cloud Workshop
product.description: A cloud-based virtual car maintenance and repair workshop platform that enables service providers to operate remotely and expand their service reach.

product.name: Service Provider Network
product.description: A network connecting fleet managers and individual customers with over 1,700 approved workshops, mobile workshops, tow services, and spare parts suppliers across Saudi Arabia.

product.name: Vehicle Transport Services
product.description: Transportation services for moving vehicles to and from workshops, including flatbed towing and roadside assistance options.

product.name: Mobile Application for Fleet Maintenance Management
product.description: A mobile app that allows users to manage vehicle fleet maintenance, schedule services, track repairs, and access service provider offers remotely.
